John / team —

Thanks — attaching audit-log-sample.jsonl.gz (small redacted extract) and a quick schema below. This is the canonical export format we support for account-level audit logs.

Sample schema (each line = JSON object):
- event_id: string (UUID)
- timestamp: ISO8601 UTC
- event_type: string (ADMIN_CHANGE | API_REQUEST | AUTH_EVENT | SYSTEM_ALERT)
- actor: { id: string, type: string (user|service) }  <-- note: in exports we flatten to actor_id, actor_type
- target: { resource_type, resource_id } <-- flattened as target_type, target_id
- request: { method, path, query_params } <-- flattened method, path
- response: { status_code, latency_ms }  <-- flattened status_code, latency_ms
- details: freeform string / structured map depending on event_type

Export/delivery options:
- On-demand export: gzipped JSONL delivered to a customer S3 bucket (signed with manifest).
- Streaming: webhook or Kinesis for real-time forwarding (we can sign payloads).
- Retention: default 90 days; configurable up to 7 years on Dedicated/Private plans.
- Immutability: exports are signed and we store write-once copies for the duration of retention; for Dedicated/Private we can enable append-only storage with retention locks.
- Integration: Splunk/Datadog/GCP PubSub/SQS supported via forwarders.

Limitations and notes:
- We redact PII fields in system-level logs by default; customer-level data access logs are available per-account with appropriate access controls.
- For HIPAA customers we can provide BAAs and additional logging of PHI-access audit trails.

If you want, I can pull a 7-day sample of your account activity (redacted) and drop it into your S3 test bucket for inspection.

—Dev Patel
Senior Engineer, Security & Platform

Emma — thanks for the quick review. Short answers:

1) Admin changes: we emit before/after in details for ADMIN_CHANGE events (actor, field_changed, old_value, new_value). We keep a full audit trail for role and permission modifications.
2) Manifest signatures: yes — we sign manifests with an RSA keypair and can publish the public cert/thumbprint for verification; manifests include per-file SHA256 checksums.
3) Retention: for Dedicated and Private customers we support immutable retention policies for 1/3/7 years; pricing varies by retention length — I'll have our finance contact provide a rate card.

Next steps I will action:
- Send NDA and SOC2 report access instructions (aditya) — target by 2026-03-16.
- Dev to run a 7-day redacted sample and push to a test S3 bucket if you share a bucket (Dev — can you confirm ETA?).
- Schedule the Wed 2026-03-18 10:00 PT call — sending calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to the call.
